sections.h2: Comprehensive Dental Care For Your Whole Family
body: From routine checkups to complete smile transformations, Dr. Brown and our team provide everything you need for a healthy, beautiful smile — all in our convenient Fort Worth location.
bullets: Dental Implants — Permanent tooth replacement that looks, feels, and functions exactly like your natural teeth.
Dental Crowns — Custom-crafted porcelain crowns that protect damaged teeth while blending seamlessly with your natural smile.
Gum Disease Laser Therapy — Advanced laser treatment for periodontal disease — less invasive, faster healing, and more comfortable than traditional methods.
Dental Bridges — Fixed bridges that fill the gap left by missing teeth, restoring your bite, speech, and smile with durable, natural-looking restorations.
Non-Surgical Root Canal — Comfortable, anxiety-free root canal therapy that saves your natural tooth and relieves pain with modern techniques and anesthesia.
Dentures — Custom full and partial dentures crafted for comfort and a natural appearance — helping you eat, speak, and smile with confidence.
Teeth Whitening — Professional Zoom® and LaserSmile in-office whitening — dramatically brighter teeth in under an hour with results that last.
Porcelain Veneers — Ultra-thin porcelain shells that cover imperfections — chips, stains, gaps, and misalignment — for a flawless Hollywood smile.
Clear Braces — Straighten your teeth discreetly with virtually invisible aligners — no metal wires, no brackets, and no impact on your daily life.
Dental Bonding — Quick, affordable cosmetic fix for chips, cracks, and gaps using tooth-colored composite resin — often completed in a single visit.
Inlays & Onlays — Custom-crafted porcelain restorations that fit precisely inside or over damaged teeth — stronger than fillings, less invasive than crowns.
Fillings & Restorations — Natural-looking, tooth-colored composite fillings that restore decayed or damaged teeth without the appearance of metal.
Dental Sealants — Protective coatings applied to the chewing surfaces of back teeth — a simple, painless way to prevent cavities in children and adults.
Tooth Extractions — Gentle, efficient tooth extractions performed with your comfort as the priority — including wisdom teeth and damaged tooth removal.
HIPAA-Compliant & Secure — Your privacy and health information are protected under full HIPAA compliance. We maintain strict data security standards across every patient interaction.
4.7★ Google Rated — Over 269 verified patient reviews reflect our commitment to outstanding care, gentle treatment, and results that consistently exceed expectations.
Accepting New Patients — We warmly welcome new patients of all ages — from young children to seniors. Most dental insurance plans accepted with same-week appointments often available.
Convenient Scheduling — Open Monday–Thursday 8am–4pm and Friday 8am–12pm, with a straightforward scheduling process designed to respect your time.
Flexible Financing — We work with most major insurance plans and offer flexible payment options to help make your dental care affordable — because your smile shouldn't wait.
Full-Scope Expertise — From a simple filling to a complete smile makeover, our team provides over 20 dental services — meaning your whole family can receive all their care in one trusted place.

faqs.q: Is Dr. Brown currently accepting new patients?
faqs.a: Yes! Marshall H. Brown, DDS & Associates is actively welcoming new patients of all ages. We typically have same-week appointments available. Simply call us at (817) 920-0882 or use our online appointment request form to get started.

faqs.q: What dental insurance plans do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept most major dental insurance plans including Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, MetLife, Humana, United Concordia, BlueCross BlueShield, and many more. We also accept CareCredit for flexible financing. Our administrative staff will work directly with your insurance provider to help maximize your benefits and minimize your out-of-pocket costs. Contact us and we'll verify your coverage before your first visit.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first appointment?
faqs.a: For your first visit, please bring a valid photo ID, your dental insurance card and completed forms (if applicable), a list of any medications you are currently taking, and any recent X-rays from your previous dentist (taken within 6 months). A parent or guardian must accompany patients under 18 years old. If you have a complex medical history, please let us know when scheduling so we can allow adequate time for your consultation.

faqs.q: Do you offer dental implants in Fort Worth?
faqs.a: Yes, dental implants are one of our most requested services. Dr. Brown has extensive experience placing and restoring dental implants for patients throughout Fort Worth and the surrounding areas. Dental implants are the gold standard for permanent tooth replacement — they look, feel, and function exactly like natural teeth. During your consultation, Dr. Brown will assess your bone density and overall oral health to determine if implants are right for you.

Our office hours are Monday – Thursday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM, and we are closed Saturday and Sunday. We are located at 1818 8th Avenue, Fort Worth, TX 76110. Call us at (817) 920-0882 to schedule an appointment.
